properties.label: Paired calibrated motion tracks
properties.text: Stack two horizontal calibrated tracks, with purpose and timing labels above each and a short note explaining their difference.

properties.label: Restrained tabular timing labels
properties.text: Use restrained tabular monospace for track names, durations, tick labels and the explanatory note.

properties.label: Green and white motion signals
properties.text: Use graphite-black, a green signal for steady motion and a white signal for the responsive transition.

properties.label: Oscilloscope-like calibrated tracks
properties.text: Construct fine vertical ticks around a sharp moving centre and a soft local halo, preserving a meaningful resting position in every track.

properties.label: Steady and responsive motion registers
properties.text: Loop the steady example linearly; let the responsive example traverse, decelerate and hold. Present them as two useful examples rather than a complete taxonomy of motion.

properties.label: Pausable visible demonstrations
properties.text: Provide a visible pause action, pause when hidden and replace movement with meaningful composed positions under reduced motion.

properties.label: Measured timing integrity
properties.text: Make actual durations match their labels and keep reading text still throughout the demonstrations.

properties.label: Loop and label acceptance
properties.text: Verify duration and loop boundaries, reject jumps into view and keep every timing label comfortably readable.
